descriptor: Cross-Provider Response-Contract Equalization, GPT-OSS Technical Recovery, Null-Boundary Prospective Replication, Selectivity-Domain Reopening & Non-Vacuous Cross-Family Geometry Constitution
design_principle: Separate response-contract failure from behavioral failure before reopening any scientific promotion gate.

phase_A_contract_calibration.canary: semantically neutral JSON-contract canary unrelated to valid/null archive classification
groq_candidate_contracts_in_order: plain JSON prompt + low reasoning + 1536 completion tokens
phase_A_contract_calibration.selection_rule: First candidate producing exact client-validated schema on 3/3 canary calls; selection is technical-only and blind to scientific outcomes.
phase_A_contract_calibration.gemini_contract: application/json + response_json_schema + identical client-side exact-schema validation
phase_A_contract_calibration.failure_rule: If no contract passes 3/3 canaries, that model remains TECHNICAL_UNRECOVERED and receives zero scientific calls.

phase_B_fresh_boundary_replication.packet_family: fresh P42 aliases and archive IDs; same six representation groups I,R,H_T_L,R_F_H,R_F_T_L,R_F_H_T_L; valid/null semantic twins

phase_C_geometry.eligibility: Only models promoted by fresh P42 evidence, never P40 shadow coordinates.
phase_C_geometry.technical_vertex_gate: >=2/3 exact-schema successful calls for each semantic twin at every vertex
phase_C_geometry.cross_family_constitution: Requires >=2 technically evaluable promoted models from distinct model families.
outputs: quotient blocks induced by identical model-response signatures across promoted models

frozen_nonpromotion_rules: Technical failure is never counted as behavioral incorrectness for promotion.
Canary contract selection cannot inspect scientific outcomes.
P40 shadow coordinates cannot promote a model.
If fewer than two distinct families promote, cross-family geometry remains NOT_CONSTITUTED rather than vacuously universal.
authority: Prospective behavioral evidence under equalized response contracts only; no neural-mechanism claim, no model-family capability ranking, no behavioral SVEC promotion.
